args.body:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out. I'm sorry to hear about the disruption — we understand how critical this is to your users and we're treating it as a top priority.

Our team has been notified and is actively investigating the integration outage. We will keep you updated with progress and an estimated resolution time as soon as possible.

If you have any additional details (error messages, affected endpoints, etc.), please share them so we can expedite the investigation.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Best regards
